== Notes ==
* Deals additional damage even if spell interruption is prevented.
* [[Normal mode]] [[foe]] [[AI]] will only use this skill to interrupt spells. [[Hero]] and [[hard mode]] foe AI will also use this to interrupt non-spell skills. <!--Tested on the [[Doppelganger]] with only [[Troll Unguent]] and Savage Shot equipped. In normal mode, it never uses Savage Shot, not even to interrupt Troll Unguent; when equipping a spell with a two-second activation time, it will use Savage Shot to interrupt the spell. In hard mode, it will use Savage Shot to interrupt Troll Unguent. Heroes will use Savage Shot to interrupt [[Master of Interrupts]]' Troll Unguent.-->
*Not counting [[elite]] or [[adrenaline]] skills, Savage Shot has the shortest recharge time of all skills that can interrupt ''any'' action.
